I have been farming this land since I was a young man, and I know what works here. I will use the manure from my goats to feed the soil because chemical fertilizer is too costly for a small plot like this, and I have kept my own yam setts from last harvest to plant again. My wives and children will help with the clearing, mounding, weeding, and harvesting, and we will depend on the rains as we always do since there is no water pump here.
